sents.text: This noob is the reason Roblox has a leave button.
sents.speaker: NARRATOR

sents.text: His name was Toby and he had one dream.
sents.speaker: NARRATOR

sents.text: Make every player feel welcome.
sents.speaker: NARRATOR

sents.text: So he joined an obby and built a giant welcome sign directly over the first jump.
sents.speaker: NARRATOR

sents.text: So he joined an obby and built a giant welcome sign directly over the first jump.
sents.speaker: NARRATOR

sents.text: You're welcome!
sents.speaker: TOBY

sents.text: Nobody could see the platforms.
sents.speaker: NARRATOR

sents.text: Then he opened a free pizza stand in a racing game.
sents.speaker: NARRATOR

sents.text: Every time a car passed, Toby stopped it to ask, pepperoni or cheese?
sents.speaker: NARRATOR

sents.text: Every time a car passed, Toby stopped it to ask, pepperoni or cheese?
sents.speaker: NARRATOR

sents.text: The entire race became a traffic jam.
sents.speaker: NARRATOR

sents.text: But Toby wasn't finished.
sents.speaker: NARRATOR

sents.text: He threw a surprise party in a hide and seek server.
sents.speaker: NARRATOR

sents.text: Balloons covered every hiding spot and he shouted everyone's names through a megaphone.
sents.speaker: NARRATOR

sents.text: Balloons covered every hiding spot and he shouted everyone's names through a megaphone.
sents.speaker: NARRATOR

sents.text: Found you!
sents.speaker: TOBY

sents.text: Happy birthday!
sents.speaker: TOBY

sents.text: Players begged the moderators to remove him.
sents.speaker: NARRATOR

sents.text: One admin kicked Toby out.
sents.speaker: NARRATOR

sents.text: He rejoined with twice as many balloons.
sents.speaker: NARRATOR

sents.text: So the developers made a brand new button that let anyone escape a server instantly.
sents.speaker: NARRATOR

sents.text: So the developers made a brand new button that let anyone escape a server instantly.
sents.speaker: NARRATOR

sents.text: Leave game!
sents.speaker: ANNOUNCER

sents.text: Players clicked it.
sents.speaker: NARRATOR

sents.text: One by one the server emptied.
sents.speaker: NARRATOR

sents.text: Finally, Toby was alone.
sents.speaker: NARRATOR

sents.text: But here's the crazy part.
sents.speaker: NARRATOR

sents.text: Toby spotted the new button and thought it was a doorbell.
sents.speaker: NARRATOR

sents.text: He clicked it 20 times and every time he rejoined he shouted, did somebody order pizza?
sents.speaker: NARRATOR

sents.text: He clicked it 20 times and every time he rejoined he shouted, did somebody order pizza?
sents.speaker: NARRATOR

sents.text: The developers were the ones who finally logged off.
sents.speaker: NARRATOR
